title: CI step misbehaving? Which part of the invocation is wrong?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Step hangs until the job limit
Step finishes, but prose is hard to parse
Review misses flaws in code it just wrote
Step needs no tool loop and can wait hours
rule: A step that hangs is an invocation problem, not an output problem. Use -p first; add output-format flags only once the step actually finishes.

title: Output is hard to use: who reads it, and what shape do they need?
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: People read it; layout and detail vary
JSON is valid but a value is wrong
Validate in code, retry with the specific error
rule: Prose is for people; schemas are for programs. When a script is the consumer, declare the output schema instead of parsing text.

title: Who needs these instructions, and how do they get them?
head: Who needs it
Right home
Why
rows: Every session in the repo, CI and laptops
rule: Ask who needs the rule. Everyone working in the repository means project CLAUDE.md; one job means that job's prompt.

title: Review is missing things: is it the reviewer, the criteria, or the size?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Misses flaws only in code the same session wrote
Independent reviewer misses one kind of flaw
Many false positives in a vague category
rule: If a reviewer misses problems only in code it wrote, separate the reviewer. Add criteria once the reviewer is independent.

title: Wrong output shape: constrain it, or repair it afterwards?
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: CLI run, consumer needs a fixed shape
API call, must always return one shape
Turn must be that tool call
Shape is right but values fail checks, time is available
Retry with the validation errors appended
Nullable field, route to a person
Retries can't find what isn't there
Need loud failure when a contract changes
rule: --output-format json gives valid JSON; --json-schema gives your JSON. Constrain at generation when a consumer has a fixed contract.

title: CI run behaves differently from local: read where it stops
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Ends fast, empty, no error, right after a tool request
Tool not permitted, nobody to approve
Allow the needed tools for the CI run
Search runs, but flags differ from local
MCP tools missing in CI only
rule: Non-interactive runs cannot approve anything. Fast, empty, error-free output right after a tool request means the tool wasn't allowed.

title: Several CI jobs, one config: which job needs what?
head: Job type
Right setting
Why
rule: Configure latency-bound, on-demand and cost-bound jobs separately. Use batch only for single-pass work; it can't run tool loops.

title: Claude in a script? Ask who reads the output
head: Need
Mechanism
Why
rows: JSON + schema, then the script posts
rule: A program reads it → --output-format json plus --json-schema.

title: Who reads the output, and through which interface?
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: Your own app calls the Messages API
Most reliable structured output on the API
People read the review, layout varies
Output parses but a value is wrong
Validate and retry with specific errors
Schemas stop syntax errors, not semantic ones
rule: In CI, code reads Claude Code's output through -p with --output-format json and --json-schema.
